where: Harness restored-chat labels and Command-O caret integration
what: Andrew saw lost on resumable chats after a daemon update and reported that Command-O did not behave like the shared cursor primitive.
cost: An idle saved conversation appeared broken, and search cursor behavior diverged from the composer.
cause: Rows showed provider-process status as conversation availability. Palette binding forced blink=true and kept a separate caret timestamp; frame scheduling enumerated chat/rename owners while excluding palette fields.
class: Presentation confuses independent lifecycle concepts, or shared primitive behavior depends on an incomplete list of feature owners.
prevention: A row presentation rule distinguishes resumable chat availability from lost processes and preserves real exit failures. Draft editors share one TextEdit/caret binding; the renderer reports actual visible caret activity for frame scheduling, independent of field ownership.
fix: Resumable chats have no lost label/failure mark and explain Ready to resume on hover. Command-O and chat share caret state/blink policy; visible blinking carets own the calm frame clock. Tests cover restored chats vs real failures and visible/hidden/steady caret activity.
